author: CampehLostAgain
body:
Hi, I'm ManiNegritas and I'm looking for team. Im interested into join an Avicus team to play some scrims and, if it is possible, a tournament. I'm actually in Punishers, an octc team (oc.tc/teams/punishers - oc.tc/ManiNegritas).

I'm mainly defender/midline (cannoner -sky -support). I prefer Spanish teams (I'm Spanish) but I dont care if you are English and you are interested. I really want a experienced team, not a new team. 

If you are intersted add me on skype: thecampermc 

Thanks for reading :D
